name: Falcon 9 (Takeoff / Landing) [Space X]
author: volker-nyc
description: A fun micro game: Space bar (Start Rocket), S (Turn off Rocket). Special thanks to Christopher Remde  for 3D model "Falcon 9 (After landing)" and Stanley Creative "Falcon 9 - Space X". Done with free Unity Assets. Thanks to the great coding teachers and Lara.
